descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you interested in working in the dynamic field of Debt Capital Markets? Do you enjoy managing multiple transactions and thrive in a fast-paced environment? Would you like to be part of a successful, collaborative team? We are looking for a professional to join our DCM Transaction Management team in Switzerland. Do you want to play a key role in executing debt capital market transactions? In this position, you will:
• work in a highly professional and collaborative environment, take responsibility for the documentation and execution of a wide range of debt capital market transactions for domestic and international clients
• provide market-technical, regulatory expertise and advisory services to internal stakeholders and external clients (issuers)
• collaborate closely with issuers, internal and external legal advisors, regulatory authorities, clearing and settlement organizations, and origination teams
• coordinate all involved parties and manage tasks that arising throughout the lifecycle of a debt transaction
